name: Par 4 Kitchen & Bar
tagline: Where great food meets game-day energy.
blurb: A modern sports bar and kitchen where great food meets game-day energy. With large screens, a craft drink list, and a warm community feel, Par 4 is where fans come together to watch, cheer, and celebrate.
capacityNote: Seats up to 60 for watch parties

name: The Flying Beaver
blurb: A Richmond institution on the water. Watch floatplanes land between plays from the heated patio, or grab a booth inside where every angle has a screen.
capacityNote: Seats up to 80 for watch parties

name: Tap & Barrel
tagline: False Creek views and forty taps.
blurb: Big, bright, and built for a crowd. The patio looks straight across False Creek and the interior turns into a wall of sound when the game is close.
capacityNote: Seats up to 100 for watch parties

name: Court House Lounge
tagline: A basketball bar that takes basketball seriously.
blurb: Low light, leather booths, and a projector wall that makes a Tuesday night NBA game feel like courtside. The cocktail list is the best on this list.
capacityNote: Seats up to 50 for watch parties

name: Stadium District Bar
tagline: The loudest room we work with, by design.
blurb: Stadium seating, a proper sound system, and a crowd that shows up in jerseys. If you want the closest thing to being in the building, this is it.
capacityNote: Seats up to 120 for watch parties

name: The Charles Bar
blurb: The kind of place where the bartender remembers your order by the second visit. Comfortable, unpretentious, and packed every time the Raptors are on.
capacityNote: Seats up to 70 for watch parties
